scripts.build:client: javascript-obfuscator src/index.js --output ./index.js --compact true --self-defending true --string-array true --string-array-encoding 'rc4' --string-array-threshold 1 --control-flow-flattening true --control-flow-flattening-threshold 1 --dead-code-injection true --dead-code-injection-threshold 1
